commands.name: bench
commands.help: Measure precision, recall, F1 and false-positive rate on the benchmark corpus.

params.name: corpus
params.help: Benchmark root containing manifest.yaml and corpus/.

params.name: split
params.help: all | dev | heldout

params.name: output
params.help: Write results JSON here.

params.name: perf
params.help: Also time 100 skills + 20 configs.

commands.name: discover
commands.help: Inventory agents, MCP servers, skills and instruction files (no findings).

params.name: no_user
params.help: Skip user-level configuration.

params.name: project
params.help: Project root (default: current directory).

commands.name: intel
commands.help: Manage the local, signed IOC feed.

commands.name: intel status
commands.help: Show which IOC feed is active.

commands.name: intel update
commands.help: Install a newer signed IOC feed (signature and rollback checks enforced).

params.name: source
params.help: Path to feed.json (a feed.json.sig must sit next to it), or an https:// URL (NETWORK).

commands.name: lock
commands.help: Write agentguard.lock: hashes of skill files and normalized tool definitions.

params.name: path
params.help: Target to lock (default: discover this machine + project).

params.name: output
params.help: Lockfile path.

commands.name: report
commands.help: Re-render a JSON report as SARIF, Markdown, HTML or terminal output (no rescan).

params.name: input
params.help: An Agent Guard JSON report.

commands.name: rules explain
commands.help: Explain one rule: what it detects, why it matters, how to fix it.

params.name: rule_id
params.help: Rule ID, e.g. AG-SKL-SE-002

commands.name: rules export
commands.help: Export the rule pack (with mappings and fixtures) as JSON for the website.

params.name: format
params.help: Only 'json' is supported.

commands.name: rules list
commands.help: List every rule in the rule pack.

params.name: json_out
params.help: JSON output.

commands.name: scan
commands.help: Scan skills, instruction files and MCP configuration. Never executes the target.

params.name: path
params.help: Skill folder, repository, or MCP config file. Omit to discover this machine's agent configuration plus the current project.

params.name: format
params.help: Output format.

params.name: output
params.help: Write output to a file.

params.name: fail_on
params.help: Exit 1 if any finding is at or above this severity (default: high).

params.name: config
params.help: Path to .agentguard.yaml (default: next to the target).

params.name: policy
params.help: Policy YAML file (overrides the policy in .agentguard.yaml).

params.name: baseline
params.help: Previous JSON report or baseline file; only new findings are reported.

params.name: changed_since
params.help: PR mode: report only components touched since this git ref. Config is read from the ref.

params.name: lock
params.help: agentguard.lock to check for drift.

params.name: no_user
params.help: When discovering, skip user-level (home directory) configuration.

params.name: live_metadata
params.help: NETWORK: fetch read-only tool lists from remote MCP servers.

params.name: auth_checks
params.help: NETWORK: check remote servers' OAuth/TLS conformance.

params.name: osv
params.help: NETWORK: look up dependencies in OSV.

params.name: provenance
params.help: NETWORK: verify npm/Sigstore provenance.

params.name: registry
params.help: NETWORK: MCP Registry / package age checks.

params.name: llm_judge
params.help: NETWORK: optional LLM judge provider: anthropic | openai_compat | ollama.

params.name: llm_model
params.help: Judge model (default for anthropic: claude-opus-5-5).

params.name: llm_endpoint
params.help: Base URL for openai_compat / ollama.

params.name: llm_budget
params.help: Maximum judge calls per scan (cached results are free).

params.name: allow_partial
params.help: Do not exit 2 when an analyzer fails (recorded in the report).

params.name: show_info
params.help: Show info-level findings in terminal output.

params.name: verbose
params.help: Show evidence, remediation and mappings.

params.name: timestamps
params.help: Include a generation timestamp (makes output non-deterministic).

commands.name: schema
commands.help: Print a JSON Schema for one of Agent Guard's data formats.

params.name: name
params.help: report | rule | lock | policy | config

commands.name: verify
commands.help: Report rug-pull / update-drift findings against agentguard.lock, with diffs.

params.name: path
params.help: Target to verify (default: discover this machine + project).

params.name: lock
params.help: Lockfile to compare against.
